question: Where can I find gallery within a 30 kilometers limit as I go from Top of the Rock, New York, NY toward Gary Lapelusa Landscaping LLC, Bayonne, NJ?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE tourism = 'gallery' AND ST_Intersects( geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Top of the Rock%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New York%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1), (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Gary Lapelusa Landscaping LLC%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Bayonne%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NJ%' LIMIT 1) )::geography, 30000 )::geography );
